content.message: The labels would name more than one process (alkt-ansokan, alkt-tillsyn), and an errand belongs to one. Labels naming two processes resolve to neither, so the errand would run none of them and be told about nothing. Take the process key off all but one of the labels. The labels a scheduled action was to add were therefore left off the errand. Take the label off the action, or give the action a condition that keeps it away from the errands it must not relabel.
Two labels resolve to different process keys
